name: dmengine-fumo-download
description: Mode C FUMO download: after the authenticated SyncML handshake the mock serves an OMA Download Descriptor; the OEM confirmation command code 10 (DMC_REQ_DL_OK) lets the real dmengine fetch the described DP object (184-byte object: 132-byte DP body with component/update tables and payload, plus a 52-byte lab HMAC trailer). The engine posts 900 Success to the descriptor installNotifyURI and logs DL session complete and advances FUMO state 30 -> 40 (and to 50 in this run). The DP is a structural lab fixture and no install or update-success claim is made.
